name: Sang Nila Utama
lore: The legendary Srivijayan prince who founded the city of Singapura (Singapore) after seeing a lion on the island. His vision transformed a small fishing village into a great trading port that would become a modern fortress.

abilities.name: Lion City Sight
abilities.description: Sang Nila Utama has +60 vision range. All Defense Towers within 400 tiles gain +15% range.

abilities.name: Fortify Position
abilities.description: Instantly constructs a temporary Defense Tower at target location. Tower lasts 45 seconds and has 50% of normal HP.

abilities.name: Singapura Bastion
abilities.description: All allied Defense Towers in a 500-tile radius become invulnerable for 12 seconds and deal 2x damage.
